verdict.rationale: A state business-filing and government portal could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring background actions, such as automated filings or renewals, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents any automation, scheduling, or autonomous background execution. The materials only describe manual portal features (profile updates, tax filing, form lookup, OHID sign-in), and the probes show the SOS hosts blocking agents at robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
